statement: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], let c : Padic p := if p=2 then 4 else (p:Padic p); let tau := fun (x : Padic p) => (∑' k : ℕ, (-1:Padic p)^k*(c*x)^(k+1)/((k+1:ℕ):Padic p))/c; ∀ x : Padic p, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖tau x‖ = ‖x‖

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 缩放对数与 Theta 值 · JA-0010 · 证明实际 p 进缩放对数级数保持整元范数

brief.zh: 先证明定义级数可和，再用非阿基米德范数和首项严格占优，包括单位输入。
brief.en: Prove summability of the defining series and apply strict ultrametric dominance, including unit inputs.
